item.title: Volunteer fireys in Mid West given funding to pay for essential equipment and training
item.description: Volunteer firefighters in the shires of Northampton and Dandaragan will be receiving financial support from the State Government and Western Power in a new round of funding announced last week.

item.title: Fisheries inquiry e-petition loses ‘most signed’ title, due to be tabled same day as a rally on Thursday
item.description: A petition which originated in Geraldton calling for an inquiry into WA’s fisheries management will be tabled in WA Parliament on Thursday, as the Nationals WA hold a rally.

item.title: Meru Waste Management Facility takes a green turn as LMS Energy starts work to reduce methane gas
item.description: Waste disposal in Geraldton has just turned a lot greener, with the City of Greater Geraldton starting work to begin gas flaring at Meru Waste Management Facility.

item.title: Tremayne B James Garlett: Geraldton man, 33, jailed for 13 months over ‘outrageous’ police pursuit
item.description: A 33-year-old man has been jailed and banned from driving for life following a police pursuit in Geraldton earlier this month.

item.title: Valuable experience for former Geraldton Buccs Alex Ducas and Johny Narkle as their maiden NBL season wraps up
item.description: Two of Geraldton’s favourite basketball sons had their first taste of NBL during the 2025-26 season, gaining valuable experience as they look to further their professional basketball careers.

item.title: Woorree Park BMX Club sees spike in new riders as new season gets under way on newly refurbished track
item.description: Geraldton’s BMX community has seen a surge in participation, as members of all ages and abilities are testing out Woorree Park BMX Club’s newly refurbished track under the lights on Fridays.

item.title: Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League: Top three locked in as Towns thwart Valley’s last ditch finals push
item.description: The Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League top three is locked in after Towns emerged on top against Chapman Valley-Northampton, who was vying for a last minute finals push last weekend.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association: Marlins take out top of table clash as Suiside stays on top in final round
item.description: Marlins’ top women’s side ended their season on a high, taking momentum into finals, while Suiside finished on top in three divisions sending a strong message as the regular season wrapped up on the weekend.

item.title: Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association: Stateside and Chapman Valley book date with Pumas in grand final
item.description: Stateside and Chapman Valley will join Pumas in the men’s and women’s Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association deciders after claiming groundbreaking wins in Monday night’s qualifying finals.

item.title: Geraldton-born trailblazer Edith Cowan’s statue installed in CBD ahead of unveiling on Wednesday
item.description: She has finally arrived — Edith Cowan has made her return to her birthplace of Geraldton, or at least her bronze likeness has, after it was installed in the CBD ahead of its unveiling on Wednesday.
